title: Blowing leaves
description: This resourcepack aims to port ~Wavy Leaves~ to Sodium
body:
# Blowing leaves

This resourcepack aims to port ~Wavy leaves~ to Sodium.

# Requirements

This resourcepack requires the [Sodium Core Shaders Support](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-core-shader-support) mod.

# Usage

Just enable this pack on your resourcepack list.

# Incompatibilities

This resourcepack is still incompatible with some resourcepack, such as ones that add **bushy leaves**, shaders such as [ReShaded](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/re-shaded) or [Energy Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/energy-shaders-java)
